primary_metric: paired mean normalized weighted score: compact-atomic minus vanilla on the 32 non-source method tasks
success_rule: primary mean difference >= +5.0 and paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
evaluation_policy: Do not modify tasks, reference requirements, weights, rubric, runtime cards, judge protocol, router prompt or Skill definitions after inspecting scored task-gain-v2 results.
All variants use the same generation model and user prompt; routed variants reuse one frozen catalog-single route per task.
legacy-raw reproduces the v1 raw upstream SKILL.md delivery as a control; compact-atomic uses only selected Runtime Cards.
full-v2 uses retrieval only for source_lookup, compact cards for method_application, compact cards plus compact composite for composite_task, and both evidence plus compact method context for mixed.
Judge sees anonymous A-E answers with deterministic per-task shuffling.
If judge_model equals generation model, record the limitation and replicate with an independent judge if results are close to decision thresholds.
